The '''Tarmidia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Kailion sector/Legends|Kailion sector]], a part of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] regions known as the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]]. By [[3996 BBY]], a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] connected the system to the [[Gerhalt system/Legends|Gerhalt]] and [[Allanteen system/Legends|Allanteen systems]]; however, the [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route had ceased to exist by [[3960 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" />

During the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], waged in 3996 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Exar Kun)/Legends|forces]] of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] sect, the Tarmidia system lay within the area that had been widely [[Scout/Legends|explored]] by the Republic and that was considered the "civilized [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]."<ref name="TEA" /> The system was the origin point of the [[Old Tarmidian]] [[Language/Legends|language]].<ref name="VotF">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Old Tarmidian]]|system=Tarmidia [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Tarmidia system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square O-13.<ref name="TEA" />
